provider.name: South Branch Grass River Spruce Mountain to First Brook public paddling access
provider.method: NYSDEC Grass River Complex lists the Spruce Mountain Road and First Brook hand-launch parking areas on the South Branch Grass River with coordinates and public-land context. The DEC page identifies the South Branch as challenging whitewater used during high water; stored points are the named hand-launch anchors and require current seasonal-road, gate, carry, waterline, and posted-rule confirmation.
